name: gpsdRelay
tagline: Relay NMEA information from Android to gpsd.
blurb: This app allows you to utilize an Android device's GPS chip as a gpsd location data provider.
description: This app allows you to utilize an Android device's GPS chip as a gpsd location data provider. UDP or TCP transport protocols are supported for supplying NMEA messages to the daemon.
